scope: IDEA000101-IDEA000106 and their six qa0 proposal files
question: Does any proposal supply a finite observable that distinguishes a semantic model from arbitrary semantic-label permutation and therefore changes the translation route?

prior_checked.finding: requires a new source-bound relation prediction; labels, fluent rendering, and formal structure alone do not identify meaning
cross-coordinate operator transfer was formal compatibility without transfer
grammar hosts and exact roundtrips were completed without concrete meanings
competing complete paragraph readings left meanings unresolved
joint context/family control failed; a shared key and held recovery were not established

candidates.reason: Reading-invariant versus reading-conditioned propositions is a meaningful rival only after an independently defined proposition endpoint. Marginalizing ZL3b/IT2a/RF1b cannot make an unobserved semantic label identifiable; either model can relabel the latent key.

This is IDEA000007's A-B-A continuity question with a renamed feature-inheritance endpoint. Participant identity and incompatible-feature judgments remain unobserved; no finite semantic contrast is supplied.

Leave-one-channel-out ranking is an identifiability/training procedure, not a new observable. Without a finite plaintext or proposition endpoint, channel ablation can select among arbitrary keys while preserving every measured structural output; it is close to GDT832/GDT360.

A held variant substitution could falsify a distinct-operation model if typed input/output states were independently observed. Here those states are analyst labels; preserving a relation-level renderer endpoint is compatible with arbitrary paraphrase names and with GDT581/GDT809-style formal reconstructions.

This repeats IDEA000070's asserted-versus-conditional operator. No independently authorial commitment cue, matched same-frame contrast, or finite falsifier is available; punctuation/layout cannot be assumed semantic.

Held encode/decode roundtrip is a stronger held-out criterion than surface fit, but its three-slot semantic representation and participant/order/state constraints are supplied by the analyst. A reversible renderer can satisfy them without identifying a word or proposition; this overlaps GDT581, GDT809 and the plan's explicit roundtrip warning.

selection.reason: None supplies both a predeclared finite semantic observable and a rival prediction that cannot be reproduced by relabeling latent meanings or rendering analyst-defined states. IDEA000104 is the closest, but needs an independently observed typed state/output relation before it becomes a source-grounded question.
selection.smallest_missing_step: Find a repeated whole-form contrast whose downstream input/output or participant relation is fixed by an admitted source feature independent of the proposed translation. Then freeze one held occurrence and its rival predictions before assigning labels.
selection.do_not_run: No decoder, renderer, corpus expansion, or semantic-gold acquisition follows from this screen.
